book.name: Luqaasa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Luqaasi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Qoodheppe Qommo Hanoteththa Gishshas Yesusa Qofiso
He wode daro derey ba giddon issoy issaara yedhettana gakkanaas shiiqi uttidaashe Yesusi bana kaallizayta, «Farsaaweta irshofe naagettite; hessika qoodheppe qommo hano.
Qonccontta kamettidi attanaynne erettontta qotan attana miishshi deenna.
Hessa gishshas intte geeman haasaydaazi wuri qoncce kezana; qasseka intte qol7an hayththan saasuketti haasaydaazi wuri dere sinththan yootettana.
Oonas Babbanaas Bessizaakko
«Ta laggetoo! Ta inttes gizay asho xalla wodhanaappe attiin hara aykkoka ooththanaas dandayonttaytas babbofte.
Gido attiin intte babbanaas bessizay oonakko ta inttena bessana; asho wodhidaappe guye ashonne shempo issife gaththi Gaanname taman yegganaas dandayzayssas babbite; ee izas babbite gays.
«Siine kafo ichchashati nam7u santes bayzetteettes; gido attiin isttafe issineyokka Xoossi dogenna.
Intte hu7e binanay kumeth taybon dees; hessa gishshas babbofte; daro Siine kafotappe intte aadhdheeta.
Kirstoosa Gishshas Markkateth
«Ta inttes yootays; ta gishshas asa sinththan markkattiza asa ubbaas Asa Nay qasseka Xoossa kiitanchcha sinththan iza gishshas markkattana.
Gido attiin asa sinththan tana kaddidaadey Xoossa Kiitanchcha sinththan kaddettana.
«Asa Naa bolla kawushsha qaala haasayzaades nagaray wuri maarettanashin Xillo Ayana cayizaadey maarettenna.
«Asay inttena oykkidi dere haarizaytakkonne godatizaytakko; Ayhuda Woosa Keeththe oykki efikko, ‹Ay gi zaarinoo? Ay giinoo?› giidi hirgofte.
Ays giikko intte haasayanaas bessizayssa Xillo Ayanay he wode inttena tamaarsana» gides.
Dure Addeza Eeyateth
Daro asaa giddofe issaadey, «Astamaaree! Ta ishay nu aawaa laata miishshaafe tana gakkizayssa taas immana mala izas yoota» gides.
Yesusikka, «Haysso! Tana intte bolla pirdiza daanna ooththiday oonee?» gides.
Qasseka isttas, «Asas daro miishshi diikkoka shemppoy he dureteththan dontta gishshas naagettite; yiiqeteththafe inttena keehi naagite» gides.
Zaareththidikka isttas, «Lo7eththi kath immiza gade godaa gidida issi dure asi dees.
He addezikka ba wozinan, ‹Ta kaththaa shiishshada woththizasoy baynda gishshas ay ooththoo?› gi qoppides.
«Addezikka, ‹Taas diza gootarata laallada hara aakkizayssa keexxana; histtada taas diza kaththaanne taas dizaaz ubbaa izan shiishshana.
Ta shemppoyee! Daro wodes gidiza kath shiishshida gishshas shempa uttada ma; uya; ufayetta› gaana gides.
«Gido attiin, ‹Xoossi haysso eeyazoo! Ne shemppoyo hach omars neeppe ekkana koyeettes; hessa gishshas ne nees shiishshidayssi oonas gidanee?› gides.
«Hessa gishshas Xoossa achchan dure gidontta baas miishshe shiishshiza asa wurseththika hessa mala» gi leemison yootides.
Xoossan Ammaneteth
Hessafe guye Yesusi bana kaallizaytas, «Inttes ta yootays; intte duussas, ‹Ay maanaakko woykko intte bollas ay may7anaakko› giidi ceecopite.
Ays giikko shemppoy kaththafe asateththi qasse may7ofe aadhdhees.
Quurota xeellite zerettenna; maxettenna; kath shiishshiza gootaray isttas baa shin Xoossi istta mizees. Histtiko intte isttafe keehi aadhdheketii?
Gido attiin inttefe darssi qoppidi ba layththa bolla issi gallas gujjana dandayzay oonee?
Histtiko guuththa miish oosoy inttes dandayettonttaashe ays hara miishshas keehi qoppeetii?
«Ciishshati waanidi diccizaakko ane xeellite; waayettenna; suqettenna; gido attiin ta inttes yootays; Solomooneykka gita asa shin isttafe issineyththo may7ibeenna.
Histtiko Xoossi hach beettidi wonto taman wodhdhana maata hayssaththo mayzizaa gidikko intteno ammanoy paccidaytoo! Inttena wostti aaththi mayizennee?
«Hessa gishshas, ‹Ay miinoo? Ay may7inoo?› giidi intte wozinay darssi qoppofo.
Biitta bollan diza asi wuri hayssa koyees; gido attiin hayssi wuri inttes koshshizayssa intte Salo Aaway erees.
Ubbaafekka koyroththidi Xoossa kawoteth koyite; hayssi wuri inttes gujetti imettana.
Sa7a Bolla Miish Shiishshanaas Bessenna
«Intteno guuththa wude mehe mala gididaytoo! Kawoteth inttes immanaas intte Aawaas lo7o qofa gidida gishshas babbofte.
Inttes dizayssa bayzidi manqotas immite; kaysoy ekkonttason, bilay monttason, cimmontta korojon wurontta miish salon shiishshite.
Intte wozinay intte miishshi dizason daana» gides.
Oosanchchata Minoteth
«Qaanththan gixxidi giigettite; intte poo7oykka poo7o,
Istta goday bullachcha diggisappe simmidi yaanaashe naagettizaytanne izi yiidi penge qoxxishin elle doyanaas giigi uttida asata misatite.
Istta goday yiza wode dhiskontta naagi uttida ashkarati istti anjjettidayta; ta inttes tumu gays; istta goday baas qaanththan gixxi eqqidi istta maaddan utissidi mizana.
Omars woykko leela giddoththan yiidi istti dhiskontta dishin demmiko he ashkarati anjjettidayta.
Kaysoy ay wode yaanaakko erizaa gididaakko keeththaa goday kaysoy bookkishin co7u giidi bessonttayssa erite.
Asa Nay intte qoppontta woden yaanayssa eridi intteka giigettidi naagite» gides.
Iita Oosanchchatanne Lo7o Oosanchchata Leemiso
Phexroosikka, «Godoo! Hayssa leemisoza ne yootizay nuus xallayee? Ubba asaassaraa?» gides.
Godaykka, «Histtiko baso asaas koshshiza woden quma immana mala keeththaadey keeththa asaa bolla woththiza ammanettida wozinama asi oonee?
Goday simmishin hessaththo ooththishe beettizaadey izi anjjettidaade.
Ta inttes tumu gays; baas diza miish ubbaa bolla hessaade godasana.
Gido attiin, ‹Izaadey ta goday elle yeenna gam7ana› gi qoppidi adde ashkaratanne macca ashkarata bukkiko, qasseka koyida mala miidinne uyidi maththottiko,
hessaade goday izi qoppontta gallassan yaana giidi ezgontta saaten yaana; histtidi iza qanxxereththi yeggidi iza exa ammanonttaytara issife ooththana.
«Ba godaa qofaa eridi giigettonttaynne godaa shene ooththontta ashkaray iita shoch shocettana.
Gido attiin erontta dishe shochchas bessiza mooro ooththida ashkaray guuththara shocettana; daro imettida asa ubbaafe daroy koyettees; daro hadara ekkidaadefe daroy koyettees.
Ubbaa Aggidi Yesusa Kaalo
«Tani yiday biitta bollan tama eeththanaassa; he tamay ha7i eexxi kezidaakko tana daro ufayssana.
Gido attiin tani xammaqettana xinqatay dees; he xinqatay polettanaashe tani keeha metotettadis.
Inttes tani biitta bolla saro ehana yidaa misatizee? Gidenna; ta inttes yootays; tani yiday issaa issaafe shaakkanaassa.
Hayssafe sinththan issi keeththan ba giddon shaakettida ichchashu asati daana. Nam7ati heedzdzata bolla heedzdzati nam7ata bolla dendidi ba giddon shaakettana.

Aaway ba attuma naa bolla, attuma naykka ba aawaa bolla, aaya ba macca nay bolla, macca nayakka ba aayey bolla, bollota ba naa machchi bolla, naa machchaka ba bolloti bolla dendidi ba giddon shaakettana» gides.
Wodeza Hanota Ero
Qasseka derezas, «Intte arshey mokkiza baggara shaaray kezishin be7idi, ‹Ellerakka iray yaana gees› geeta; intte gida malakka hanees.
Dugeha baggara pudeha carkishin, ‹Gallassay ho7o gidana› geeta; intte gida malakka hanees.
Intteno Lo7o misatiza iitatoo; saloyssanne sa7a medha be7idi hananayssa ereeta shin ha wodeza eroy inttena waani xoonizee?»
«Histtiko intte ays tuma pirdeketii?
Morkkera Sigeteth

«Ne morkkera daanna sinththan eqqana bishin buro oge bollan dashe izara giigana oge koya; ne histtontta aggiko izi nena goochchidi daanna sinth efana; daannayka nena aaththidi halaqas immana; halaqaykka nena woynen yeggana.
Ta nees yootays; daannay pirdida wurseththa santiyo qanxxa wursana gakkanaas ne heeppe kezakka» gides.
